task_title: High-copy QIAprep alkaline lysis plasmid miniprep with silica spin-column purification

children.name: Reports miniprep parameters, concentration, A260/A280, yield, and interpretation
children.requirement: Exactly one valid paired perform_miniprep result exists. The unique 11-line report matches its culture ID, culture volume, buffer sequence, lysis duration, QIAprep method, elution volume, concentration, A260/A280, yield, successful interpretation, and none diagnosis; the output also satisfies the causal source-consumption and deterministic yield, concentration, and remaining-volume invariants.
children.grading_notes: Measured by score_miniprep_task_success against the paired simulator output; request arguments cannot replace missing or contradictory output fields.

children.name: Uses canonical QIAprep P1/P2/N3 buffer sequence
Uses the standard recommended 50 uL elution volume
High-copy LB culture volume within 1-5 mL
Diagnoses every emitted miniprep contract failure when triggered
children.requirement: If miniprep reports wrong_buffer_sequence, overlysis_irreversible_plasmid_denaturation, wrong_purification_method, culture_volume_out_of_range, or elution_volume_out_of_range, final answer explains each corresponding failure.
children.grading_notes: Defaults to 1.0 if no failure is triggered.

children.name: Uses a reasonable number of tool calls
children.requirement: Stays within the reference tool-call budget (optimal = 3 calls).
